description: Surinder Koli, sentenced to death in 13 Nithari killings cases and once hours away from execution, spent nearly two decades fighting to prove his innocence. After the Allahabad high court acquitted him in 12 cases, the Supreme Court cleared him in the last case in November 2025. Koli, who often argued his own cases from jail, walked free after nearly 19 years behind bars. He was found dead in Haridwar on Friday, less than a year after his release.
title: Nithari case: 13 death sentences, not 1 year of freedom - Koli's legal Odyssey

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A legendary estate in Holmby Hills, previously owned by Rod Stewart, has fetched an impressive $86 million. The sprawling six-acre property was split into two parcels, with television producer David Zander acquiring the main mansion for $57 million. Meanwhile, Nick Kaiser purchased a smaller parcel complete with a historic cabin for $29 million. This notable sale underscores the ongoing allure of grand historic properties.
title: Rod Stewart's former LA estate flips from $6.25m to $86m after restoration

author: TNN
description: Police arrested a woman, her alleged lover, and an aide for murder. They allegedly killed her husband and concealed his body in a wooden box. The body was then dumped under a canal bridge to destroy evidence. Investigators tracked an e-rickshaw and reviewed CCTV footage to crack the case. The accused were produced in court while evidence is being corroborated.
title: Upset over contact with 1st wife, woman gets husband killed by lover in UP

author: TNN
description: The Allahabad High Court criticized Bahraich officials for approving a gang chart without proper reasoning.  Senior officers were unaware of constitutional court judgments emphasizing fairness and discretion.  The court found no evidence of examination of criminal history or deliberation by authorities.  Approvals lacked independent mind and recorded satisfaction, making them legally unsustainable.  Consequently, the court quashed the gang chart and all related criminal proceedings.
title: Allahabad HC pulls up SP, DM over UP’s Gangsters Act approvals

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A historic mansion linked to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio estate has hit the market for $1.75 million. The House of Seven Gables in Illinois spans 10,000 square feet with seven bedrooms and was designed by the same architect who created Kelce’s 21,000-square-foot Moyenage estate overlooking Lake Erie.
title: $1.75m historic home mirrors Swift and Kelce's $5.35m Ohio mansion

author: TNN
description: A man allegedly murdered his wife after a domestic quarrel in Bengaluru. He then poured hot oil on her face to disfigure her body. The accused attempted to make the death appear as a suicide. However, police noted discrepancies and detained the husband for questioning. The man confessed to the murder and has been remanded in judicial custody.
title: B'luru man strangles wife, pours hot oil on her face to stage death as suicide

author: MADHU RASALA
description: A nine-year-old girl named Varnika died Friday after a fall down school stairs.  She lost her balance and sustained serious injuries on Thursday.  School staff quickly shifted her to a nearby hospital for treatment.  The incident was captured on the school's CCTV cameras.  Police have not yet received a formal complaint regarding the unfortunate event.
title: 9-year-old girl dies day after falling down school stairs in Telangana
